clauses.heading: 1. Past Performance
clauses.quote: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 80% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU.
clauses.summary: The bidder or its OEM must have supplied similar products for 80% of the bid quantity in one of the last three financial years to a government body or PSU.

clauses.heading: 1. Past Performance
clauses.quote: Copies of relevant contracts (proving supply of cumulative order quantity in any one financial year) to be submitted along with bid in support of quantity supplied in the relevant Financial year.
clauses.summary: Copies of contracts proving the supplied quantity in the relevant financial year must be submitted with the bid.

clauses.quote: The bidder should have supplied the same or similar category products for at l east 80% of the bid quantity in any one of the last three financial years precedin g the bid opening date.
